samples.question: Find the grayscale square immediately inside the four colored corner squares. It was recorded by circularly shifting row r to the right by (3r) pixels, wrapping at 256, where r=0 is the top row. Undo that shift by moving row r left by (3r) pixels, then replace every pixel by the centered 7x7 mean using edge replication. Ignore the marks and frame. Which symbol appears: ring, cross, triangle, or zigzag?
